ctbids-48170-5624553.description:
This estate collection features a multi-piece lot of vintage and estate pearl jewelry, including classic strands, specialty beads, and boxed earrings.
-The lot includes three beaded style necklaces featuring silver-tone fishhook safety clasps marked "14 KG".
- Included is an 18-inch strand with approximately 8 mm knotted beads; a 20-inch strand with graduated beads ranging from 3.5 mm to 7 mm (retaining its original $75 price tag); and a matching 20-inch strand with graduated 3.5 mm to 7 mm knotted beads.
-Also included in the lot is a 16-inch untested single strand of rice pearls (approx. 9 mm) and a 16-inch double strand beaded necklace fastened with a classic toggle clasp (ring and bar clasp).
- Completing the collection are two pairs of earrings. The first set is a pair of classic Majorca (Mallorca) organic man-made simulated pearl studs (approx. 6 mm) set on 14KT Gold Filled posts, presented in their original green velvet presentation box along with personal provenance paperwork.
- The second set is a pair of pierced single-pearl drop earrings with clear rhinestone accents (approx. 7 mm pearls); one pearl has detached from its setting and is missing a prong, making it an ideal repair project.
-Please note: standard jewelers' testing for pearl authenticity (natural, cultured, or faux) has not been performed on these items; all pieces are sold as-is.
*** Estimated Secondary Market Values:
-18" Knotted Bead Necklace (14 KG marked clasp, 8 mm): $40
- 20" Graduated Knotted Bead Necklace (14 KG marked clasp, $75 tag attached): $40
-20" Graduated Knotted Bead Necklace (14 KG marked clasp): $40
-16" Rice Pearl Strand (unmarked clasp, 9 mm): $25
-16" Double Strand Beaded Necklace with Toggle Clasp: $20
- Boxed Mallorca Pearl Stud Earrings (14KT GF Posts, 6 mm, Green Velvet Box): $30
- Rhinestone & Pearl Drop Earrings (7 mm, Needs Prong Repair): $15
***Estimated Lot Total: $200
-Items Show Wear & Tear Consistent With Age - Items Are Sold As Is - Untested Unless Stated Otherwise- Manufacturers Are Not Verified or Authenticated - We Show What We Find As The Maker's Mark.

278930810.description: This vintage collection includes seven small clear specimen containers, each holding a different mineral or rock sample in colors such as clear, amber, green, brown, and yellow.
